lines.text: Nabal was a wealthy man in Maon with a thousand goats and three thousand sheep, and his wife was Abigail.
David sent ten young men to Nabal at Carmel, but Nabal insulted them, so David told his men to strap on swords.
Abigail loaded donkeys with food, told her husband Nabal first, and met David and his men in a mountain ravine.

wrong_details.true: she did not tell her husband Nabal

lines.text: Abigail bowed before David, and he blessed the LORD for sending her and told her to go home in peace.
Abigail told Nabal the news that night, and ten days later the LORD struck Nabal dead and David sent for her.

wrong_details.wrong: told Nabal the news that night
wrong_details.true: she told him nothing until morning light, when he was sober
